stem:
Parul's class plans ways to protect life on Earth, including cutting greenhouse gases, protecting habitats, using cleaner energy, and saving water.

Which claim best explains why protection needs connected actions rather than one isolated fix?

options.text: Because Earth's water, living things, air, and land systems are connected, cutting greenhouse gases, protecting biodiversity, using cleaner energy, and saving resources must work together.
Protecting only one Earth system is enough because the others never affect each other.
Reuse and recycling alone replace the need to cut greenhouse gases or protect habitats.
Connected Earth systems mean no individual or community action can help at all.

teacher.key_rationale: Connected Earth systems mean climate, biodiversity, cleaner energy, and resource-saving actions must work together. Isolating one system, treating reuse as a full substitute, or saying no local action helps all miss that hinge.
